name: Ki Healing
body:
Owning mastery over your own internal energies and familiarity with their healthy patterns, you are able to heal your ki more rapidly than others.

Prerequisite(s): Ki pool class feature

Benefit: You ki pool is replenished for every four hours of rest or meditation.

Normal: The ki pool is replenished each morning after 8 hours of rest or meditation; these hours do not need to be consecutive.
